title: On Transferability of Bias Mitigation Effects in Language Model Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating false positive rate differences (FPRD) on sentences containing specific demographic group identifiers (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Black') using a New York Times corpus and the Identity Phrase Templates Test Sets (IPTTS) in hate speech detection tasks.

Measuring false positive rates on text written in African American Vernacular English (AAVE) using an off-the-shelf AAVE dialect predictor and the BROD dataset to evaluate spurious toxicity classifications.

Measuring F1 score differences between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical coreference examples using the WinoBias dataset, and calculating true positive rate (TPR) differences in predicting occupations for men and women using the BiasBios dataset.
